text:
### Variation Basis  
- **Review Frequency:** Monthly
- **Trigger:** Bank of England Base Rate changes
- **Basis:** BoE Base Rate + 2.5% Margin (fixed margin)
- **Notification:** Email alert when rate changes (customer can opt-in)
- **Effective Date:** Rate change effective 1st of following month
name: Chunk 5/34

raw_entities.name: Savings Account with Variable Rate
raw_entities.description: A savings product with interest rates that vary based on Bank of England Base Rate changes. The product features a fixed margin of 2.5% above the BoE Base Rate, with rates reviewed monthly and adjusted on the 1st of the following month.
context: Bank of England Base Rate changes
BoE Base Rate + 2.5% Margin (fixed margin)
Rate change effective 1st of following month

raw_entities.name: Rate Change Notification
raw_entities.description: Customers receive email alerts when interest rates change on their savings account. This is an opt-in feature that notifies customers of rate adjustments triggered by Bank of England Base Rate movements.
context: Email alert when rate changes (customer can opt-in)
Notification: Email alert when rate changes

raw_entities.name: Variable Rate Tier
raw_entities.description: The interest rate applied to the savings account, calculated as Bank of England Base Rate plus a fixed margin of 2.5%. This rate is reviewed monthly and adjusted effective the 1st of the following month.
context: BoE Base Rate + 2.5% Margin (fixed margin)
Review Frequency: Monthly
Basis: BoE Base Rate + 2.5% Margin (fixed margin)

raw_entities.name: Rate Variation and Notification Clause
raw_entities.description: Contractual provision governing how and when interest rates are adjusted on the savings account. Specifies that rate changes are triggered by Bank of England Base Rate movements, reviewed monthly, and become effective on the 1st of the following month, with customer notification via email.
context: Review Frequency: Monthly
Trigger: Bank of England Base Rate changes
Effective Date: Rate change effective 1st of following month
